# English learning audio

Original teaching sentences synthesized locally using CMU Flite SLT, US English. This is synthetic speech, not a recorded human performance. Engine/voice notices are in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt. License source: https://github.com/festvox/flite/blob/master/COPYING

The slow clips use pitch-preserving tempo0.85. No publisher teaching recordings are copied. Original text/transcripts are in the replaceable English audio manifest.
